name: Day 16 — 參觀日 The Big Day

readings.title: 客人來了 The Guests Arrive

qs.q: Where do the guests sit?
What is served to the guests?
What do the guests say?

gram.d: 請 in front of a verb turns it into a courteous invitation: 請坐 please sit, 請進 please come in, 請喝茶 please have tea. Hosting in Taiwan runs on this three-word toolkit — deploy all three within the first minute.

readings.title: 歡迎董事長 Welcoming the Chairman

qs.q: When did the chairman's car arrive?
What does Mr. Wang quietly ask about?
What time is lunch booked for?

gram.t: verb + 得 + how — describing the manner
gram.d: 得 links a verb to how it's done: 笑得很好看 smiles beautifully, 準備得很好 prepared well, 說得太快 speaks too fast. This is the everyday 得 — master it and your descriptions instantly sound native.

readings.title: 故事③：舊報紙 Story ③: The Old Newspaper

qs.q: What does the wife find online?
What did the owner do during that typhoon forty years ago?
ch: Kept the shop open all night feeding people sheltering from the rain

qs.q: What does the narrator realize at the end?
ch: He may owe money for a bowl of noodles from forty years ago

gram.t: 難道…？ — could it really be…?
gram.d: 難道 turns a statement into stunned disbelief: 難道我欠的是四十年前的麵？ Could it be I owe for noodles from forty years ago?! 難道你不知道？ Don't tell me you didn't know? Pure rhetorical drama — the storyteller's question mark.

readings.title: 飛行示範 The Flight Demonstration

qs.q: What is the final stop of the tour?
How did the demo compare to practice?
ch: Not only smooth, but the drone flew even steadier

qs.q: What was the chairman especially interested in?

gram.t: 不但…而且… — not only… but also…
gram.d: Stack two positives (or two negatives): 示範不但順利，而且飛得更穩。 Not only smooth — even steadier. Same subject: 不但 goes after it. This is your OPI upgrade from 'and': it shows structured, weighted argument.

readings.title: 合作可望擴大 Cooperation Set to Expand

qs.q: How is this executive visit regarded?
ch: An important milestone in the partnership

qs.q: What did the chairman not rule out?
What do analysts say about a smooth signing next month?
ch: The long-term outlook can be expected to rise further

gram.t: 可望 — can be expected to
gram.d: 可望 + outcome is the analyst's hedge-plus-hope: 前景可望更上一層樓 the outlook can be expected to climb further, 物價可望回穩 prices should stabilize. Softer than 將, stronger than 可能 — exactly the confidence level financial news lives at.

dict.py: Jīntiān yǒu zhòngyào de kèrén.

qs.q: What does the wife remind him to wear?
What does she want tonight?
ch: For him to tell her how it went

dict.py: Jiǔ diǎn bàn dàjiā dōu yào dàowèi.
dict.en: Everyone must be in position by nine thirty.

dict.py: Dǒngshìzhǎng de chē zhǔnshí dào le.
dict.en: The chairman's car arrived right on time.

dict.py: Huānyíng huānyíng, qǐng zhè biān zǒu!
dict.en: Welcome, welcome — this way please!

dict.zh: 中午的餐廳訂位訂好了。
dict.py: Zhōngwǔ de cāntīng dìngwèi dìng hǎo le.
dict.en: The lunch reservation is all booked.

dict.py: Bié jǐnzhāng, wéixiào jiù hǎo!
dict.en: Don't be nervous — just smile!

pass.zh: 提醒大家：客人十點到，九點半請到自己的位置。看到董事長的時候，記得微笑，說「歡迎光臨」。中午十二點去餐廳，位子我已經訂好了。

qs.q: What should everyone say when they see the chairman?
What is already arranged for twelve o'clock?

dict.zh: 這家餐廳的招牌菜是什麼？
dict.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhāopáicài shì shénme?
dict.en: What's this restaurant's signature dish?

dict.py: Lái, wǒmen yìqǐ gānbēi!
dict.en: Come on — let's toast together!

dict.py: Jīntiān de qìfēn zhēn hǎo.
dict.en: The atmosphere today is wonderful.

dict.zh: 吃完飯，我們拍一張合照吧。
dict.py: Chī wán fàn, wǒmen pāi yì zhāng hézhào ba.
dict.en: After the meal, let's take a group photo.

dict.py: Wǒ jìng dǒngshìzhǎng yì bēi!
dict.en: A toast to the chairman!

pass.zh: 各位，今天謝謝大家的招待！這家的招牌菜真的名不虛傳。來，我敬大家一杯——祝我們合作愉快，下個月簽約順利！吃完飯我們在門口拍張合照，做個紀念。

qs.q: What does the speaker toast to?
ch: Happy cooperation and a smooth signing next month

qs.q: What happens at the door after the meal?

dict.py: Zuìhòu yí zhàn shì cèshì qū.
dict.en: The final stop is the testing area.

dict.py: Wǒ xiān jièshào jīběn de cāozuò.
dict.en: First I'll introduce the basic operation.

dict.py: Fēixíng shìfàn xiànzài kāishǐ.
dict.en: The flight demonstration begins now.

dict.zh: 董事長很關心續航的時間。
dict.py: Dǒngshìzhǎng hěn guānxīn xùháng de shíjiān.
dict.en: The chairman is very interested in the endurance time.

dict.zh: 今天飛得比練習的時候更穩。
dict.py: Jīntiān fēi de bǐ liànxí de shíhòu gèng wěn.
dict.en: It flew even steadier today than in practice.

pass.zh: 導覽就到這裡，最後歡迎董事長體驗一下操作。這台的續航是九十分鐘，風大的時候也很穩。您放心，操作很簡單，我在旁邊帶著您，來，這個是起飛的按鈕。

qs.q: What is the chairman invited to do at the end?
What is the stated endurance?

dict.zh: 這次參訪被視為重要的里程碑。
dict.py: Zhè cì cānfǎng bèi shìwéi zhòngyào de lǐchéngbēi.
dict.en: This visit is regarded as an important milestone.

dict.py: Duìfāng bù páichú zēngjiā tóuzī.
dict.en: The other side isn't ruling out increased investment.

dict.zh: 雙方將進一步擴大合作規模。

pass.zh: 產業快訊：南部無人機大廠董事長今日北上參訪合作夥伴，雙方對測試結果都表示滿意。據了解，除了原本的訂單，對方也在評估增加投資，擴大長期合作。市場認為，若九月順利簽約，這將是台灣無人機產業今年最受注目的合作案之一。

qs.q: Besides the original order, what is being evaluated?
ch: Increasing investment and expanding long-term cooperation

qs.q: If the September signing goes smoothly, how does the market see this deal?
ch: One of the year's most watched drone-industry partnerships in Taiwan

scenarios.intro: Big day. Your wife has opinions about your shirt, your breakfast, and your confidence level. Accept all three.

them.zh: 今天客人要來，你緊張嗎？
them.py: Jīntiān kèrén yào lái, nǐ jǐnzhāng ma?
them.en: The guests come today — are you nervous?

turns.task: A little — but you're ready.

ans.zh: 有一點，可是我準備好了！
ans.py: Yǒu yìdiǎn, kěshì wǒ zhǔnbèi hǎo le!
ans.en: A little — but I'm ready!

them.zh: 穿這件藍色的襯衫，很好看！
them.py: Chuān zhè jiàn lánsè de chènshān, hěn hǎokàn!
them.en: Wear this blue shirt — it looks great!

turns.task: Agree and thank her.

ans.zh: 好，謝謝老婆！
ans.py: Hǎo, xièxiè lǎopó!
ans.en: OK — thanks, honey!

them.zh: 客人來的時候，要說什麼？
them.py: Kèrén lái de shíhòu, yào shuō shénme?
them.en: When the guests arrive, what do you say?

turns.task: Practice: welcome, please sit, please have tea.

ans.zh: 歡迎！請坐，請喝茶！
ans.py: Huānyíng! Qǐng zuò, qǐng hē chá!
ans.en: Welcome! Please sit, please have tea!

them.zh: 很好！那杯子呢？乾淨的嗎？
them.py: Hěn hǎo! Nà bēizi ne? Gānjìng de ma?
them.en: Perfect! And the cups? Are they clean?

turns.task: Yes — the office bought new cups.

ans.zh: 放心，公司買了新的杯子！
ans.py: Fàngxīn, gōngsī mǎi le xīn de bēizi!
ans.en: Relax — the office bought new cups!

them.zh: 太好了！晚上回來跟我說喔！
them.py: Tài hǎo le! Wǎnshàng huílái gēn wǒ shuō ō!
them.en: Wonderful! Tell me all about it tonight!

turns.task: Promise — and off you go!

ans.zh: 好！我出門了，晚上見！
ans.py: Hǎo! Wǒ chūmén le, wǎnshàng jiàn!
ans.en: Will do! I'm off — see you tonight!

scenarios.intro: 9:57 AM. The car is turning into the driveway. Xiaomei runs the door; you run the timing.

them.zh: 車來了車來了！大家都到位了嗎？
them.py: Chē lái le chē lái le! Dàjiā dōu dàowèi le ma?
them.en: The car's here! Is everyone in position?

turns.task: Yes — everyone got in position at nine thirty.

ans.zh: 都到位了，大家九點半就準備好了。
ans.py: Dōu dàowèi le, dàjiā jiǔ diǎn bàn jiù zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
ans.en: All in position — everyone was ready at nine thirty.

them.zh: 哇，他們很準時！我好緊張喔！
them.py: Wā, tāmen hěn zhǔnshí! Wǒ hǎo jǐnzhāng ō!
them.en: Wow, they're right on time! I'm so nervous!

turns.task: Calm her — don't be nervous, just smile.

ans.zh: 別緊張，微笑就好！
ans.py: Bié jǐnzhāng, wéixiào jiù hǎo!
ans.en: Don't be nervous — just smile!

them.zh: 董事長下車了！我要說什麼？
them.py: Dǒngshìzhǎng xià chē le! Wǒ yào shuō shénme?
them.en: The chairman's getting out! What do I say?

turns.task: Welcome him warmly and invite him this way.

ans.zh: 說「歡迎光臨，請這邊走」！
ans.py: Shuō "huānyíng guānglín, qǐng zhè biān zǒu"!
ans.en: Say 'Welcome — right this way, please'!

them.zh: 好！對了，中午的訂位沒問題吧？
them.py: Hǎo! Duìle, zhōngwǔ de dìngwèi méi wèntí ba?
them.en: Got it! Oh — the lunch reservation is set, right?

turns.task: Booked — twelve o'clock, and the private room is confirmed.

ans.zh: 訂位訂好了，十二點，包廂也確認過了。
ans.py: Dìngwèi dìng hǎo le, shí'èr diǎn, bāoxiāng yě quèrèn guò le.
ans.en: Reservation's booked — twelve o'clock, private room confirmed.

them.zh: 你最可靠了！好，我上場了！
them.py: Nǐ zuì kěkào le! Hǎo, wǒ shàngchǎng le!
them.en: You're the most reliable! OK — I'm on!

turns.task: Send her off — tell her she's got this.

ans.zh: 加油，你一定沒問題的！
ans.py: Jiāyóu, nǐ yídìng méi wèntí de!
ans.en: Go get 'em — you've totally got this!

scenarios.intro: Private room, round table, chairman at the head seat. Toasts will happen. Know your signature dish and your toast etiquette.

them.zh: 這家餐廳不錯喔！你們常來嗎？
them.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng búcuò ō! Nǐmen cháng lái ma?
them.en: This restaurant is nice! Do you come often?

turns.task: For important guests, yes — and recommend the signature dish.

ans.zh: 重要的客人我們都帶來這裡，他們的招牌菜是烤鴨，一定要試試！
ans.py: Zhòngyào de kèrén wǒmen dōu dài lái zhèlǐ, tāmen de zhāopáicài shì kǎoyā, yídìng yào shìshì!
ans.en: We bring all our important guests here — the signature dish is roast duck, you have to try it!

them.zh: 來來來，董事長說要敬大家一杯！
them.py: Lái lái lái, dǒngshìzhǎng shuō yào jìng dàjiā yì bēi!
them.en: Here we go — the chairman wants to toast everyone!

turns.task: Raise your glass — toast to happy cooperation and a smooth signing.

ans.zh: 乾杯！祝我們合作愉快，下個月簽約順利！
ans.py: Gānbēi! Zhù wǒmen hézuò yúkuài, xià ge yuè qiānyuē shùnlì!
ans.en: Cheers! To happy cooperation and a smooth signing next month!

them.zh: 哈哈，說得好！今天的氣氛真的很好。
them.py: Hāhā, shuō de hǎo! Jīntiān de qìfēn zhēn de hěn hǎo.
them.en: Haha, well said! The atmosphere today is really wonderful.

turns.task: Agree — it's because everyone worked hard, from the typhoon to today.

ans.zh: 對啊，從颱風到今天，大家都很努力，才有這麼好的氣氛。
ans.py: Duì a, cóng táifēng dào jīntiān, dàjiā dōu hěn nǔlì, cái yǒu zhème hǎo de qìfēn.
ans.en: Right — from the typhoon till today everyone worked hard, that's why the mood is this good.

them.zh: 董事長很少這麼開心。你們的示範，他非常滿意！
them.py: Dǒngshìzhǎng hěn shǎo zhème kāixīn. Nǐmen de shìfàn, tā fēicháng mǎnyì!
them.en: The chairman is rarely this happy. He's extremely satisfied with your demo!

turns.task: You're honored — say the team will keep it up.

ans.zh: 太榮幸了！我們團隊會繼續努力的。
ans.py: Tài róngxìng le! Wǒmen tuánduì huì jìxù nǔlì de.
ans.en: We're honored! Our team will keep up the good work.

them.zh: 吃完飯，我們在門口拍張合照吧，做個紀念！
them.py: Chī wán fàn, wǒmen zài ménkǒu pāi zhāng hézhào ba, zuò ge jìniàn!
them.en: After lunch, let's take a group photo at the door — for the memory!

turns.task: Great idea — you'll ask the restaurant staff to help take it.

ans.zh: 好主意！我請餐廳的人幫我們拍合照。
ans.py: Hǎo zhǔyì! Wǒ qǐng cāntīng de rén bāng wǒmen pāi hézhào.
ans.en: Great idea! I'll ask the restaurant staff to take the group photo for us.

scenarios.intro: The drone is airborne and the most important man in the room is asking questions. Answer like the engineer you are — clearly, confidently, in Mandarin.

them.zh: 飛得很穩！這台的基本操作難不難學？
them.py: Fēi de hěn wěn! Zhè tái de jīběn cāozuò nán bù nán xué?
them.en: Very stable flight! Is the basic operation hard to learn?

turns.task: Not hard — with the guided tour and training, new operators learn it in a week.

ans.zh: 不難，有導覽跟訓練的話，新的操作人員一個星期就能上手。
ans.py: Bù nán, yǒu dǎolǎn gēn xùnliàn dehuà, xīn de cāozuò rényuán yí ge xīngqí jiù néng shàngshǒu.
ans.en: Not hard — with a guided walkthrough and training, new operators pick it up in a week.

them.zh: 我最關心續航。實際上可以飛多久？
them.py: Wǒ zuì guānxīn xùháng. Shíjì shàng kěyǐ fēi duōjiǔ?
them.en: Endurance is my main concern. How long can it actually fly?

turns.task: Ninety minutes standard — and in today's wind it stayed stable the whole time.

ans.zh: 標準續航是九十分鐘，今天風不小，全程也都很穩。
ans.py: Biāozhǔn xùháng shì jiǔshí fēnzhōng, jīntiān fēng bù xiǎo, quánchéng yě dōu hěn wěn.
ans.en: Standard endurance is ninety minutes — and with today's wind it stayed stable the whole way.

them.zh: 不錯。如果下雨或風更大，示範還能進行嗎？
them.py: Búcuò. Rúguǒ xiàyǔ huò fēng gèng dà, shìfàn hái néng jìnxíng ma?
them.en: Not bad. And if it rains or the wind gets stronger — can a demo still proceed?

turns.task: Honest answer: heavy rain grounds it; you'd move indoors and demonstrate with video and simulation.

ans.zh: 大雨的話就不能飛，我們會改到室內，用影片跟模擬來示範。
ans.py: Dàyǔ dehuà jiù bùnéng fēi, wǒmen huì gǎi dào shìnèi, yòng yǐngpiàn gēn mónǐ lái shìfàn.
ans.en: In heavy rain it can't fly — we'd move indoors and demonstrate with video and simulation.

them.zh: 很誠實，我欣賞。你們的導覽安排得很專業。
them.py: Hěn chéngshí, wǒ xīnshǎng. Nǐmen de dǎolǎn ānpái de hěn zhuānyè.
them.en: Very honest — I appreciate that. Your guided tour is arranged very professionally.

turns.task: Thank him — the whole team rehearsed to give him the clearest picture.

ans.zh: 謝謝董事長！我們全隊演練了很多次，就是希望讓您看得最清楚。
ans.py: Xièxiè dǒngshìzhǎng! Wǒmen quán duì yǎnliàn le hěnduō cì, jiùshì xīwàng ràng nín kàn de zuì qīngchǔ.
ans.en: Thank you, Chairman! The whole team rehearsed many times so you'd get the clearest picture.

them.zh: 年輕人，好好做。九月簽約以後，我們還有很多事要一起做。
them.py: Niánqīngrén, hǎohǎo zuò. Jiǔ yuè qiānyuē yǐhòu, wǒmen hái yǒu hěnduō shì yào yìqǐ zuò.
them.en: Keep it up, young man. After the September signing, we'll have much to do together.

turns.task: Accept the encouragement — you look forward to the long-term cooperation.

ans.zh: 謝謝董事長的鼓勵，我們很期待跟貴公司長期的合作！
ans.py: Xièxiè dǒngshìzhǎng de gǔlì, wǒmen hěn qídài gēn guì gōngsī chángqí de hézuò!
ans.en: Thank you for the encouragement — we look forward to a long-term partnership with your company!

scenarios.intro: The cars have left. The boss closes the door and wants the real readout: what did today actually buy us?

them.zh: 辛苦了！今天整體來說，你怎麼評估？
them.py: Xīnkǔ le! Jīntiān zhěngtǐ láishuō, nǐ zěnme pínggū?
them.en: Great work! Overall, how do you assess today?

turns.task: A milestone — the demo exceeded expectations and the chairman said so directly.

ans.zh: 我認為是一個里程碑，示範比預期更好，董事長也直接說了他很滿意。
ans.py: Wǒ rènwéi shì yí ge lǐchéngbēi, shìfàn bǐ yùqí gèng hǎo, dǒngshìzhǎng yě zhíjiē shuō le tā hěn mǎnyì.
ans.en: I'd call it a milestone — the demo beat expectations, and the chairman said directly he was satisfied.

them.zh: 他有提到九月以後的計畫嗎？
them.py: Tā yǒu tídào jiǔ yuè yǐhòu de jìhuà ma?
them.en: Did he mention plans beyond September?

turns.task: Yes — he isn't ruling out increased investment and expanding the scale of cooperation.

ans.zh: 有，他說不排除增加投資，進一步擴大合作的規模。
ans.py: Yǒu, tā shuō bù páichú zēngjiā tóuzī, jìnyíbù kuòdà hézuò de guīmó.
ans.en: Yes — he said he's not ruling out more investment and further expanding the scale of cooperation.

them.zh: 投資的部分，我們要注意什麼？
them.py: Tóuzī de bùfèn, wǒmen yào zhùyì shénme?
them.en: On the investment side — what should we watch?

turns.task: Advise: clarify terms before the signing so both deals don't get tangled.

ans.zh: 我建議在簽約以前先把投資的條件談清楚，不要讓兩件事混在一起。
ans.py: Wǒ jiànyì zài qiānyuē yǐqián xiān bǎ tóuzī de tiáojiàn tán qīngchǔ, búyào ràng liǎng jiàn shì hùn zài yìqǐ.
ans.en: I suggest clarifying the investment terms before the signing, so the two deals don't get tangled together.

them.zh: 同意。長期來看，你覺得這個合作的前景怎麼樣？
them.py: Tóngyì. Chángqí lái kàn, nǐ juéde zhège hézuò de qiánjǐng zěnmeyàng?
them.en: Agreed. Long term — how do you see this partnership's outlook?

turns.task: Optimistic — with their channels plus your technology, the outlook should climb another level.

ans.zh: 我很樂觀。有他們的通路加上我們的技術，長期的前景可望更上一層樓。
ans.py: Wǒ hěn lèguān. Yǒu tāmen de tōnglù jiāshàng wǒmen de jìshù, chángqí de qiánjǐng kěwàng gèng shàng yì céng lóu.
ans.en: I'm optimistic — their channels plus our technology, the long-term outlook should climb another level.

them.zh: 好。那接下來到簽約前，你的工作重點是什麼？
them.py: Hǎo. Nà jiēxiàlái dào qiānyuē qián, nǐ de gōngzuò zhòngdiǎn shì shénme?
them.en: Good. Between now and the signing — what are your priorities?

turns.task: Three things: confirm the contract details, track the delivery schedule, and prepare the signing-day agenda.

ans.zh: 三件事：確認合約的細節、追蹤交期，還有準備簽約當天的流程。
ans.py: Sān jiàn shì: quèrèn héyuē de xìjié, zhuīzōng jiāoqí, háiyǒu zhǔnbèi qiānyuē dàngtiān de liúchéng.
ans.en: Three things: confirm the contract details, track the delivery schedule, and prepare the signing-day agenda.

x: 今天公司有重要的客人。
Jīntiān gōngsī yǒu zhòngyào de kèrén.
The company has important guests today.
vocab.n: 客 guest + 人. 請客 = to treat someone (you're the host, you pay). 客氣 polite — guests everywhere in this word family.

x: 請坐，請喝茶！
Qǐng zuò, qǐng hē chá!
Please sit — please have some tea!
vocab.n: The host's opening move. Full set: 請進 come in → 請坐 sit → 請喝茶 tea. Three phrases, instant Taiwanese hospitality.

x: 杯子是新的，茶是熱的。
Bēizi shì xīn de, chá shì rè de.
The cups are new and the tea is hot.
vocab.n: Measure word for drinks is bare 杯: 一杯茶, 兩杯咖啡. 馬克杯 mug, 環保杯 reusable cup — very Taiwan.

x: 客人坐在沙發上。
Kèrén zuò zài shāfā shàng.
The guests sit on the sofa.
vocab.n: Loanword from 'sofa' — say it and you already knew it. 沙發馬鈴薯 couch potato made the jump too.

x: 歡迎光臨，請這邊走！
Huānyíng guānglín, qǐng zhè biān zǒu!
Welcome — right this way!
vocab.n: 歡迎光臨 rings out in every shop in Taiwan. Doubled 歡迎歡迎 = extra warmth at the door.

x: 別緊張，微笑就好！
Bié jǐnzhāng, wéixiào jiù hǎo!
Don't be nervous — just smile!
vocab.n: 微 slight + 笑: the composed professional smile. 笑 alone can be laughing; 微笑 never loses control.

x: 董事長的車準時到了。
Dǒngshìzhǎng de chē zhǔnshí dào le.
The chairman's car arrived right on time.
vocab.n: 準 accurate + 時 time. 準時到 arrive on time; opposite 遲到. Business-culture note: for VIPs, 提早到 beats 準時到.

x: 中午的餐廳訂位訂好了。
Zhōngwǔ de cāntīng dìngwèi dìng hǎo le.
The lunch reservation is booked.
vocab.n: 訂 book + 位 seat. Same 訂 chain: 訂房 book a room, 訂票 book tickets. On the phone: 我要訂位，四位，七點。

x: 來，我們一起乾杯！
Lái, wǒmen yìqǐ gānbēi!
Come on, let's toast!
vocab.n: Literally 'dry the cup' — historically you emptied it. Modern Taiwan: 隨意 'as you wish' is the merciful counter-offer.

x: 這家的招牌菜是烤鴨。
Zhè jiā de zhāopáicài shì kǎoyā.
This place's signature dish is roast duck.
vocab.n: 招牌 shop sign + 菜: the dish the sign hangs on. Asking 你們的招牌菜是什麼？ is the smartest ordering move in Taiwan.

x: 吃完飯，我們拍張合照吧！
Chī wán fàn, wǒmen pāi zhāng hézhào ba!
After the meal, let's take a group photo!
vocab.n: 合 together + 照 photo. 拍合照 take one, 跟…合照 photo WITH someone — the fan-meeting verb.

x: 今天的氣氛真好。
Jīntiān de qìfēn zhēn hǎo.
The atmosphere today is wonderful.
vocab.n: Rooms, dinners, meetings, dates all have 氣氛. 破壞氣氛 kill the mood; 炒氣氛 hype the room up. Taiwan pronunciation: qìfēn.

x: 我負責今天的導覽。
Wǒ fùzé jīntiān de dǎolǎn.
I'm in charge of today's guided tour.
vocab.n: 導 lead + 覽 view: museum audio guides (語音導覽) and factory walkthroughs alike. 導覽人員 = docent/guide.

x: 基本操作一個星期就能學會。
Jīběn cāozuò yí ge xīngqí jiù néng xuéhuì.
Basic operation can be learned in a week.
vocab.n: Machines, software, systems: 操作手冊 operations manual, 操作人員 operator. Your daily verb for anything with controls.

x: 這台的續航是九十分鐘。
Zhè tái de xùháng shì jiǔshí fēnzhōng.
This unit's endurance is ninety minutes.
vocab.n: 續 continue + 航 voyage: 續航力/續航時間 for drones, EVs, phones. The spec every UxS customer asks about first — as the 董事長 just proved.

x: 飛行示範現在開始。
Fēixíng shìfàn xiànzài kāishǐ.
The flight demonstration begins now.
vocab.n: 示 show + 範 model. 示範怎麼做 demo how it's done. Cousin of 展示: 展示 displays a thing, 示範 performs a skill.

x: 雙方將擴大合作的規模。
Shuāngfāng jiāng kuòdà hézuò de guīmó.
Both sides will expand the scale of cooperation.
vocab.n: 擴 widen + 大: 擴大合作, 擴大產能, 擴大市場. Headline verb for anything growing on purpose.

x: 對方不排除增加投資。
Duìfāng bù páichú zēngjiā tóuzī.
The other side isn't ruling out increased investment.
vocab.n: 投 throw + 資 capital. 投資人 investor, 外資 foreign capital. 投資有賺有賠 — 'investments can gain or lose' — Taiwan's mandatory fund-ad disclaimer, recited at auctioneer speed.

x: 這個產業的前景很好。
Zhège chǎnyè de qiánjǐng hěn hǎo.
This industry's outlook is bright.
vocab.n: 前 ahead + 景 scenery: the view forward. 前景看好 outlook positive — analyst-speak staple. Not 風景 (actual scenery).

x: 這次參訪是合作的重要里程碑。
Zhè cì cānfǎng shì hézuò de zhòngyào lǐchéngbēi.
This visit is an important milestone in the partnership.
vocab.n: 里程 mileage + 碑 stone tablet — a literal road marker gone corporate. 重要的里程碑 = every press release's favorite phrase.

slang.e: it's in the bag, locked in
x: 董事長笑成那樣，這個案子穩了啦！
Dǒngshìzhǎng xiào chéng nàyàng, zhège ànzi wěn le la!
With the chairman smiling like that, this deal is in the bag!
slang.n: 穩 stable + 了: outcome secured. The confidence call before results land. Jinx-reversal cousin: 穩死的 = definitely doomed.

x: 小美今天接待超罩的，完全沒出錯。
Xiǎoměi jīntiān jiēdài chāo zhào de, wánquán méi chūcuò.
Xiaomei was rock-solid on reception today — zero mistakes.
slang.n: Literally 'to cover': someone who covers for the team. 很罩/超罩 high praise; 罩我一下 = cover me. Taiwan campus-to-office staple.

slang.e: like using cheat codes, unfairly good
x: 無人機今天飛成這樣，根本開外掛！
Wúrénjī jīntiān fēi chéng zhèyàng, gēnběn kāi wàiguà!
The drone flew so well today it's basically running cheats!
slang.n: 外掛 = game cheat plugin; 開 turns it on. For performance too good to be legal. Gaming-born, now everywhere.

x: 一次就成功，太神啦！
Yí cì jiù chénggōng, tài shén la!
Nailed it on the first try — godlike!
slang.n: 神 god as peak praise: 神人 a legend, 神操作 genius move. The 啦 makes it a cheer — PTT's favorite exclamation.

x: 今天有夠順利，大家都鬆了一口氣。
Jīntiān yǒugòu shùnlì, dàjiā dōu sōng le yì kǒu qì.
Today went SO smoothly — everyone finally exhaled.
slang.n: Hokkien intensifier fused into Taiwan Mandarin: 有夠熱 crazy hot, 有夠貴 seriously pricey. Drop it before any adjective and sound instantly local.
